text_blocks.snippet: The updated COVID-19 vaccines for the 2024-2025 season are designed to target the JN.1 lineage of the Omicron variant, providing better protection against currently circulating strains. These updated vaccines replace the original mRNA shots from Pfizer and Moderna, which were effective against the initial SARS-CoV-2 virus. The bivalent vaccines, introduced in 2022, were an earlier attempt to address the evolving virus, but the 2024-2025 vaccines are more closely tailored to current variants.
